about: Vectors for repairDecision (FAC-SEM-129, docs/specification/node-summary.md#repairs; DEC-0101, DEC-0102, DEC-0115), written by tools/vectors/repair-decision.ts, never by hand. Each case is repairDecision(input) and its expected answer {decision, reason?}; absent values are absent members. Every request is signed with Ed25519 (its value standard base64) over the settings canonical form of the request without signature (policySigningInput), by the test key whose 32-byte seed is keys.policy.seed (SHA-256 of a fixed label); keys.other signs the request another key made. The order is already-answered, bad-signature, wrong-device, expired, policy-expired, not-allowlisted, person-declined; a key's window is judged at at (an absent bound open, one that does not read closing it); a request with no canonical form (a fraction, a lone surrogate) is refused as bad-signature; a machine with role org-cloud skips only the person step. Every case holds in every time zone.
